newsitem.title: LATVIA: BOURSE TO APPROVE FREE LIST LINE-UP THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE TO APPROVE FREE LIST LINE-UP THURSDAY.

text.p: The Riga bourse said on Wednesday it will approve the line-up of its third or free list tomorrow.
"The board will approve the line-up of the third list and changes to the official and secondary list," Guntars Kokarevich, manager of the bourse's finance department, told Reuters.
The bourse decided to introduce a free list after it introduced tighter disclosure requirements for secondary list stocks.
Companies on the free list will not have to meet the same standards of transparancy.
"Only the companies, having signed an agreement on the provision of financial information, will be included in the secondary list," he added.
"The formation of the secondary and free list will be in process all throughout July," he said. "We have an agreement in place with 19 of the current secondary list companies."
"We can expect the Brasa furniture, Tukums forestry and Liepaja cannery, delisted earlier for poor financial showings, to also to be included in the free list," Kokarevich said.
"Their figures are still weak," he added.
